enemies.name: Forest Guardian
enemies.description: Ancient protector spirit of the Verdance groves.

enemies.name: Shadow Stalker
enemies.description: Dark predator that hunts during Silver Sap phases.

enemies.name: Crimson Warden
enemies.description: Corrupted warrior empowered by Crimson Sap.

enemies.name: Timber Wolf
enemies.description: A common predator of the Verdance forests.

enemies.name: Thorn Sprite
enemies.description: Tiny plant spirits that swarm in groups.

enemies.name: Root Crawler
enemies.description: Insectoid burrower that ambushes from underground.

enemies.name: Sap Beetle
enemies.description: Beetle that feeds on crystallized sap.

enemies.name: Bark Spider
enemies.description: Web-spinning predator that drops from the canopy.

enemies.name: Fungal Slime
enemies.description: Gelatinous fungal mass that spreads spores.

enemies.name: Corrupted Treant
enemies.description: Once-noble tree spirit consumed by Blight.

enemies.name: Spore Crawler
enemies.description: Giant fungal crawler that debuffs with toxins.

enemies.name: Crystal Golem
enemies.description: Animated crystal construct from the old Emerald mines.

enemies.name: River Serpent
enemies.description: Aquatic predator of the Emerald Cascades.

enemies.name: Vine Wraith
enemies.description: Spectral plant spirit that entangles prey.

enemies.name: Hollow Knight
enemies.description: Fallen Bloomguard corrupted by the Hollowing.

enemies.name: Abyssal Imp
enemies.description: Lesser demon from beyond the Veil.

enemies.name: Ancient Treant
enemies.description: Massive tree guardian of the deepest groves.

enemies.name: Shadow Weaver
enemies.description: Veil-touched entity that manipulates shadows.

enemies.name: Bloodthorn Beast
enemies.description: Crimson-phase predator with thorned hide.

enemies.name: Deeproot Guardian
enemies.description: Ancient root network defender.

enemies.name: Crystal Sentinel
enemies.description: Elite crystal construct with magical abilities.

enemies.name: Sporelord Mycel
enemies.description: Boss: Sporecaller faction leader.

enemies.name: The Hollow King
enemies.description: Boss: Lord of the corrupted Hollowroot realm.

enemies.name: Abyssal Warden
enemies.description: Boss: Veil guardian twisted by the Abyss.

enemies.name: Nexus Guardian
enemies.description: Boss: Final guardian of the Nexus.

enemies.name: Sap Leech
enemies.description: Parasitic creature that drains DSP from the world when it strikes.

enemies.name: Thornback Bear
enemies.description: Massive ursine predator with thorns growing from its hide.

enemies.name: Blight Beetle Swarm
enemies.description: A chittering mass of corrupted beetles that overwhelm through numbers.

enemies.name: Corrupted Dryad
enemies.description: Once-beautiful tree spirit twisted by Blight into a vengeful caster.

enemies.name: The Blighted Oakfather
enemies.description: Boss: Ancient tree lord consumed by corruption. Act 1 final boss.

enemies.name: The Crimson Maw
enemies.description: Boss: A terrifying Abyss entity that manifests during Crimson Sap surges. The final boss.

enemies.name: Veil Wisp
enemies.description: Fragments of the Whispering Veil given weak form. They hunt during Silver Sap.

enemies.name: Rot Grub
enemies.description: Blighted larvae that swarm in Crimson phase. Weak but numerous.

enemies.name: Canopy Stalker
enemies.description: Predatory creature that hunts from the high canopy. Favors ambush.

enemies.name: Ember Sprite
enemies.description: Tiny Crimson Sap elementals. They explode when cornered.

enemies.name: Moss Golem
enemies.description: Living mound of moss and roots. Slow but nearly unbreakable.

enemies.name: Thorn Harrier
enemies.description: Flying thorn-creature that harries travelers. Common in Spindlewood.

enemies.name: Sap Ghost
enemies.description: Spirit bound to spilled Sap. Drains the living to sustain itself.

enemies.name: Blight Hound
enemies.description: Corrupted wolf-like beast. Hunts in packs near Blight zones.

enemies.name: Root Sentinel
enemies.description: Smaller kin of the great Root Sentinels. Guards sacred groves.

enemies.name: Corrupted Vine Creeper
enemies.description: A tangled mass of corrupted vines that slithers through the underbrush, strangling anything in its path.

enemies.name: Hollowed Sprite
enemies.description: A once-gentle forest sprite consumed by the Hollowing, now a bitter husk of flickering spite.

enemies.name: Catacomb Crawler
enemies.description: Pale insectoid horror that infests the ancient catacombs beneath the Verdance, feeding on the dead.

enemies.name: Keeper Sentinel
enemies.description: Ancient stone automaton that guards forgotten vaults. Still follows its last orders after centuries of silence.

enemies.name: Crystal Wraith
enemies.description: Spectral entity bound to shattered crystal formations, phasing between the material and arcane planes.

enemies.name: Spore Thrall
enemies.description: A once-living creature overtaken by parasitic fungal growth, now a shambling vessel for spore propagation.

enemies.name: Shadow Echo
enemies.description: Residual imprint of a soul lost to the Veil, replaying its final moments in an endless aggressive loop.

enemies.name: Corrupted Officer Varn
enemies.description: Former Bloomguard officer consumed by Crimson Sap corruption. Retains tactical intelligence and fighting skill.

enemies.name: Thornmaw Alpha
enemies.description: Pack leader of the thornmaw predators, a massive beast with a jaw lined with razor-sharp wooden spines.

enemies.name: Veil Horror
enemies.description: Nightmarish entity from beyond the Whispering Veil, its form shifting and unstable, inducing terror in all who behold it.

enemies.name: Corruption Elemental
enemies.description: Pure corruption given form, a roiling mass of dark sap and blighted energy that poisons the land around it.

enemies.name: Poacher Leader
enemies.description: Ruthless commander of a band of Verdance poachers, skilled in both blade and trap.

enemies.name: Veil Phantom
enemies.description: Spectral remnant that drifts between the Veil and reality, phasing through solid matter to strike the unwary.

enemies.name: Spore Lord
enemies.description: Boss: Massive fungal overlord that commands legions of spore thralls, spreading blight wherever it roots.

enemies.name: Void Herald
enemies.description: An emissary of the Abyss, heralding the arrival of greater void entities with waves of annihilating energy.

enemies.name: Corrupted Guardian
enemies.description: Once a noble protector of the Nexus, now a towering corrupted sentinel that serves the Blight with terrible power.

enemies.name: Void Wisp
enemies.description: A flickering mote of void energy that drifts through corrupted zones, searing anything it touches.

enemies.name: Abyssal Crawler
enemies.description: Multi-limbed horror that scuttles from void rifts, dragging prey back into the darkness.

enemies.name: Shadow Imp
enemies.description: Minor demon cloaked in shadow, darting in to strike before vanishing into darkness.

enemies.name: Void Tendril
enemies.description: A writhing appendage of void energy reaching through a rift, lashing at anything within range.

enemies.name: Grove Sprite
enemies.description: Mischievous nature spirit that pelts intruders with bursts of pollen and thorns.

enemies.name: Ember Fox
enemies.description: A small vulpine creature wreathed in crimson embers, quick to bite and quicker to flee.

enemies.name: Corrupted Sapling
enemies.description: Young tree animated by Blight, its bark cracked and oozing dark sap as it lashes out with twisted branches.

enemies.name: Crystal Stag
enemies.description: Majestic deer with crystalline antlers that channels arcane energy. Territorial and dangerous when provoked.

enemies.name: Prism Wraith
enemies.description: Spectral being that refracts light into blinding bursts, disorienting prey before striking.

enemies.name: Ancient Rootworm
enemies.description: Enormous segmented worm that burrows through root networks, erupting beneath the unwary.

enemies.name: Echo Phantom
enemies.description: A spectral replay of a fallen warrior, repeating its battle movements in an endless ghostly loop.

enemies.name: Thornmaw Dryad
enemies.description: A dryad who bonded with thornmaw beasts, commanding packs of predators while casting nature magic.

enemies.name: Memory Wraith
enemies.description: A powerful spirit formed from concentrated memories of the dead, wielding arcane knowledge stolen from forgotten minds.

enemies.name: Void Sentinel
enemies.description: A guardian construct corrupted by void energy, its crystalline shell now pulsing with abyssal power.

enemies.name: Abyssal Mage
enemies.description: Mortal sorcerer who traded their soul for abyssal power, casting devastating void-infused spells.

enemies.name: Shadow Assassin
enemies.description: Elite void-touched killer that strikes from stealth with lethal precision, vanishing before retaliation.

enemies.name: Blighted Treant
enemies.description: A young treant infected by Blight, its bark cracking and leaking corrupted sap as it stumbles through the forest.

enemies.name: Corrupted Elder
enemies.description: An ancient grove elder consumed by corruption, wielding twisted nature magic and commanding blighted minions.

enemies.name: Corruption Wraith
enemies.description: Spectral manifestation of concentrated Blight energy, spreading decay wherever it drifts.

enemies.name: Corrupted Thornweaver
enemies.description: Former Thornbinder taken by corruption, weaving deadly thorn constructs infused with dark sap.

enemies.name: Decay Knight
enemies.description: Undead warrior clad in corroded armor, animated by necrotic sap and driven to destroy the living.

enemies.name: Void Parasite
enemies.description: Leech-like void organism that attaches to living hosts, draining their life force to fuel its growth.

enemies.name: Memory Guardian
enemies.description: Spectral protector assembled from the collective memories of fallen defenders, guarding places of significance.

enemies.name: Rift Stalker
enemies.description: Predatory void entity that hunts by tearing small rifts in reality, striking from impossible angles.

enemies.name: Mirror Horror
enemies.description: Aberration that mimics the appearance of its prey, creating disorienting reflections before attacking.

enemies.name: Abyssal Knight
enemies.description: Elite warrior of the Abyss clad in void-forged armor, wielding devastating dark energy in melee combat.

enemies.name: Abyssal Brute
enemies.description: Hulking demon of raw void muscle, slow but capable of devastating physical attacks that shatter armor.

enemies.name: Corruption Colossus
enemies.description: A mountain of corrupted earth and wood, animated by concentrated Blight into a walking siege engine.

enemies.name: Void Harbinger
enemies.description: A towering void entity that serves as vanguard for abyssal invasions, tearing reality apart with each step.

enemies.name: Scar Guardian
enemies.description: Ancient protector bound to a scarred leyline, drawing immense power from the wounded earth to crush trespassers.

enemies.name: Rift Lord
enemies.description: A void sovereign that commands rifts between planes, summoning endless minions through tears in reality.

enemies.name: Void Architect
enemies.description: Boss: Supreme intelligence of the Abyss that designs the void incursions into the Verdance, reshaping reality itself.
